base_contracts.definition_ko: 기준면 바깥 법선과 월드 아래 방향의 각도입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Reference-face angle is not intended edge/corner target error.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 모서리·꼭짓점 목표 자세 오차가 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Signed slope of the recorded long local face axis: asin((positive-side mean height - negative-side mean height) / axis length), in degrees.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 기준면 긴 로컬 축의 양·음쪽 평균 높이 차이를 축 길이로 나눈 값의 역삼각 각도입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Signed local-axis tilt, not target error.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 축 방향에 따라 부호가 바뀌며 목표 오차가 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Signed slope of the recorded short local face axis, from opposite-side mean heights and its recorded length.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 기준면 짧은 로컬 축 양·음쪽의 부호 있는 경사각입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Signed local-axis tilt, not target error.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 기록된 로컬 축을 기준으로 해석합니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Exact minimum-height corner identities among all eight corners at the validated precontact sample. Ties are shown together.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 8개 꼭짓점의 정확한 최저 높이를 표시하고 동률은 모두 표시합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Nearly tied or flat minima are noise-sensitive. Exact ties are non-unique; no unique-corner agreement.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 평평하거나 비슷한 높이는 잡음에 민감하며 동률에 유일 꼭짓점 일치를 부여하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Maximum minus minimum of the four fixed reference-face heights at the validated precontact sample.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 고정 기준면의 네 꼭짓점에서 최대 높이와 최소 높이의 차이입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Entry posture differs from a whole-window peak.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 입사 자세 값이며 전체 구간의 최대값과 다릅니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Target down-direction error
base_contracts.definition: Angle between observed box-local down and an independently approved target down direction at the validated precontact sample.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 별도로 승인한 로컬 아래 방향과 관측 아래 방향 사이 각도입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Down-direction diagnostic leaves yaw unconstrained; no ISTA tolerance or verdict.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 아래 방향 주위 yaw는 제한하지 않으며 ISTA 허용오차나 합격 판정이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Lowest-corner gap
base_contracts.definition: Second-lowest minus lowest of all eight finite world-Y corner heights at the validated precontact sample.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 접촉 직전 8개 높이 중 두 번째 최소와 최소의 차이입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Zero is legitimate for face/edge geometry; gap is not confidence or a pass threshold.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 면·모서리에서 0은 정상이며 신뢰도나 합격 기준이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Peak DeltaH
base_contracts.definition: Maximum reference-face height range over the complete selected interval, using one fixed reference face.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 전체 구간에서 고정 기준면 높이 차이의 최대값입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Peak may occur during rebound/toppling; use entry DeltaH for incoming posture.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 반등·전도 때 최대가 될 수 있으므로 입사 자세는 접촉 직전 값을 사용합니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: The most down-facing of all six faces at the pre-onset sample, or the first usable pose when no such sample exists. Long/short axes follow its recorded extents.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 접촉 직전 또는 첫 유효 자세에서 아래를 가장 향한 면을 여섯 면 중 선택합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Coordinate reference is not confirmed contact or final face. Public selection considers all six faces.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 접촉이나 최종 정착면이 아닌 좌표 기준이며 전체 구간에 고정합니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Final face
base_contracts.definition: Most down-facing of all six faces after an equal-weight rotation mean of the stable-height tail. An observed unstable tail is Unsettled; missing evidence is unavailable.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 안정 높이 조건을 통과한 끝 구간의 동일 가중 회전 평균에서 아래를 향한 면입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Height plateau does not prove rotational rest.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 높이 안정 조건만으로 실제 회전 정지를 입증하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Actual recorded seconds of the finite sample strictly preceding detector onset in the same continuous observed segment.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 검출기 시작 표본보다 엄격히 앞선 같은 연속 관측 구간의 실제 표본 시각입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Detector onset and first accepted persistent contact can differ. First-row onset has no prior sample.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 인정된 첫 지속 접촉과 검출기 시작 시각은 다를 수 있습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Pre-contact candidate detected
base_contracts.definition: Whether the contact detector supplied a pre-onset candidate. A separate comparison validator checks its consistency.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 공개 검출기가 접촉 직전 후보를 제공했는지 표시합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Saved true does not bypass first-event validation.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 저장된 참 값이 비교 검증을 우회하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Actual recorded start time of the first constant nonempty contact set lasting at least two samples.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 같은 비어 있지 않은 접촉 집합이 두 표본 이상 지속된 첫 사건의 시작 시각입니다.
base_contracts.caution: First accepted persistent event can follow detector onset.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 검출기 시작 또는 직전 표본과 같은 시각이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Corner identities in the first accepted persistent contact set, interpreted under the recorded contact policy.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 첫 지속 사건에서 추정한 꼭짓점 집합입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Geometric corner set, not force measurement.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 접촉력 측정이나 기준면이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Ordered constant nonempty contact-set runs lasting at least two samples. An empty interval separates runs, including recurrence of the same set.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 두 표본 이상 지속된 일정한 비어 있지 않은 접촉 집합의 순서입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Exact sequence depends on accepted-event segmentation; not a verdict.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 빈 구간은 사건을 나누며 분할 규칙에 의존하는 진단이지 합격 판정이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Accepted contact count
base_contracts.definition: Number of accepted persistent contact-set runs in complete usable contact analysis. A genuine absence of accepted runs is zero.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 전체 구간에서 인정된 접촉 집합 구간 수입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Zero requires usable complete contact analysis.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 분석 근거가 없으면 0으로 대신하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Pre-contact saved vertical velocity
base_contracts.definition: Stored geometric-centre vertical derivative at the validated precontact sample, in mm/s, positive along world Y up.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 저장된 기하중심 월드 수직 미분값을 실제 접촉 직전 표본에서 읽습니다.
base_contracts.caution: Ideal height assumes supported free fall; neither release height nor package performance.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 이상적 속도 환산높이는 지원 자유낙하를 전제로 하며 방출높이나 포장 성능이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Peak descent speed
base_contracts.definition: Nonnegative maximum descent magnitude from interval start through the precontact sample: max(0, -minimum stored vertical velocity). Every required sample must be finite and supported.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 구간 시작부터 접촉 직전까지 완전한 저장 수직속도에서 최대 하강 크기를 구합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Incomplete intervals are unavailable; no NaN skipping.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 결측을 건너뛰지 않으며 모두 상승인 유효 구간은 0입니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Pre-contact saved horizontal speed
base_contracts.definition: Magnitude of the two stored horizontal geometric-centre velocity components at the validated precontact sample, in the world XZ plane.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 저장된 기하중심 월드 XZ 속도 성분의 크기입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Saved snapshot and one-sided fit differ in method and time.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 한쪽 구간 경로 fit과 방식·시각이 다릅니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Pre-contact saved angular speed
base_contracts.definition: Stored angular-velocity norm at the validated precontact sample, in rad/s.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 저장된 각속도 크기를 접촉 직전 표본에서 읽습니다.
base_contracts.caution: Saved angular norm and one-sided rotation fit differ.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 분석 프레임 성분이나 한쪽 회전 fit으로 대체하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Ideal geometric-centre vertical-speed equivalent height
base_contracts.definition: For an explicitly approved Type G free fall, ideal height in mm is the strictly downward stored geometric-centre vertical speed squared divided by 2*9810. This uses a saved sample, not the registered-COM path fit.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 승인된 Type G 자유낙하에서 저장 수직속도 제곱을 2×9810으로 나눈 높이입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Ideal geometric-centre kinematic equivalent is not release height or registered-COM fit; no automatic verdict.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 방출높이·등록 질량중심 fit·자동 판정과 다릅니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Contact-path direction
base_contracts.definition: Direction of the signed principal-angle sum between consecutive accepted contact radii in the world-Y horizontal plane. Consistency below 0.5 is Indeterminate.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 기하중심 기준 수평 접촉 반경의 주각 이동합으로 방향을 정합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Contact-path direction is not a rigid-body angular-velocity component sign.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 강체 각속도 성분 부호가 아니며 일관성이 0.5 미만이면 불확정입니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Net sweep angle
base_contracts.definition: Absolute signed sum of consecutive contact-radius principal angles, in degrees. Counter-directed steps cancel; angles are not unwrapped.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 접촉 반경의 부호 있는 연속 이동각 합의 절댓값입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Opposing steps cancel. Net sweep is not accumulated angular travel; segmentation matters.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 반대 방향 이동은 상쇄되며 누적 이동각이 아닙니다. 사건 분할에 의존합니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Sweep consistency
base_contracts.definition: Absolute signed contact-angle sum divided by the sum of absolute contact-angle steps. Real cancellation yields zero; absent or degenerate travel is unavailable.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 부호 있는 이동합의 크기를 절대 이동각 합으로 나눈 비율입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Real cancellation zero differs from undefined travel.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 실제 상쇄의 0과 이동 자체가 없는 미산출을 구분합니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Whole-interval contact classification, in priority order: ImpactEvent, SustainedContact, Approach, NoContact. Incomplete evidence is unavailable.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 전체 구간을 충격 사건·지속 접촉·접근·무접촉 우선순위로 분류합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Overall classification, not per-frame phase or package quality.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 표본별 단계나 품질 판정이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Whether a new threshold onset after the first row or supported motion onset was detected.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 구간 시작 이후 임계값 접촉 또는 운동 근거로 새 사건을 검출했는지 표시합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Stable plateau alone is not a new impact.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 안정적인 낮은 높이만으로 충격을 검출하지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Whether the tail satisfies the public low-height, low-variation and low-speed evidence gates. This can coexist with a detected impact.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 끝 구간의 낮고 안정적이며 느린 높이 근거를 표시합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Stable height alone does not establish t1 or rotational rest.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 충격과 함께 참일 수 있으며 자체로 접촉 직전 시각을 만들지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Bounded diagnostic score combining public threshold, motion and plateau evidence. The ImpactEvent comparison adds first-event consistency checks.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 임계값·운동·안정 구간 근거를 가중한 0부터 1까지의 점수입니다.
base_contracts.caution: Algorithm diagnostic score, not calibrated probability.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 교정된 확률이나 포장 품질 점수가 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.definition: Labels of recorded contact evidence: threshold, motion, plateau, trend, or none. The display validates them against the public contact analysis.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 임계값·운동·안정·추세 등 실제 검출 근거를 표시합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Evidence labels, not a standardized verdict.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 표준 판정이나 자동 보정이 아닙니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

base_contracts.name: Intended contact match
base_contracts.definition: Existing contact owner result after its full registration, independent intent, review, processing and event checks. Only this summary translates Match/Different/Unclear to Match/Mismatch/Unknown.
base_contracts.definition_ko: 독립 작업자 의도와 기존 owner가 검증한 첫 접촉을 비교합니다.
base_contracts.caution: Mismatch is not automatic failure. Owner Match/Different/Unclear maps to Match/Mismatch/Unknown only in this adapter.
base_contracts.caution_ko: 불일치는 자동 불합격이 아니며 미확인은 일치로 바꾸지 않습니다.
base_contracts.reason_policy: ResolvedMetric.status/reason preserve the actual owner and geometry/provenance gates; unavailable never becomes a fabricated zero.

series_context_policy: Full-column tuple identities; one selected-series card is rendered on demand, separate from t1/peak/fit values.
